2610.12416.title: MAMHOI: Factorizing Scene-Aware Human-Object Interaction through Affordances
2610.12416.paper_summary: Generating realistic human-object interactions (HOI) in complex 3D scenes requires two complementary capabilities: reasoning about interaction feasibility in the environment and synthesizing realistic human-object motion. However, supervision for these capabilities is rarely available jointly at scale. Human-scene datasets provide rich information about environment-aware motion, while human-object datasets capture detailed interaction dynamics, yet paired human-object-scene data remain scarce. We present MAMHOI, an affordance-mediated factorization for scene-aware human-object interaction generation. MAMHOI factorizes scene-aware HOI generation through an explicit motion-affordance interface between scene understanding and motion synthesis: a scene-conditioned model first predicts where and how an interaction can be feasibly executed, and an affordance-conditioned HOI model then generates the corresponding human-object motion. This factorization allows scene understanding and interaction dynamics to be learned from complementary sources of supervision without requiring paired human-object-scene data. Experiments in complex indoor environments show that MAMHOI reduces object--scene penetration while better preserving human--object interaction quality, yielding more realistic and physically feasible scene-aware interactions. Project page: https://leimingyuan.github.io/MAMHOI-project-page/
2610.12416.paper_summary_zh: 生成複雜 3D 場景中的現實人類-物體互動 (HOI) 需要兩種互補的能力：對環境中互動可行性的推理以及合成現實的人類-物體運動。<lb/>然而，這些能力的監督在規模上很少同時可用。<lb/>人類-場景數據集提供了關於環境感知運動的豐富信息，而人類-物體數據集則捕捉了詳細的互動動態，然而配對的人類-物體-場景數據仍然稀缺。<lb/>我們提出了 MAMHOI，一種基於可供性介導的場景感知人類-物體互動生成的因式分解。<lb/>MAMHOI 通過場景理解和運動合成之間的明確運動-可供性介面來因式分解場景感知的 HOI 生成：一個場景條件模型首先預測互動可以在何處以及如何可行地執行，然後一個可供性條件的 HOI 模型生成相應的人類-物體運動。<lb/>這種因式分解允許從互補的監督來源學習場景理解和互動動態，而無需配對的人類-物體-場景數據。<lb/>在複雜的室內環境中的實驗顯示，MAMHOI 減少了物體-場景的穿透，同時更好地保留了人類-物體互動的質量，產生了更現實且物理上可行的場景感知互動。<lb/>項目頁面： https://leimingyuan.github.io/MAMHOI-project-page/
